item.title: The Carney Paradox: Elbows Up, Knees Down
item.description: Six months into his mandate, Prime Minister Mark Carney's confrontational rhetoric toward the United States stands in stark contrast to his accommodating policy actions. This investigation reveals the growing gap between campaign promises and governing reality, and asks: where is this contradiction leading Canada?

item.title: Briefing: Canada's 2025 Federal Budget - Key Highlights and Economic Measures
item.description: The 2025 Canadian Federal Budget introduces tax relief measures, affordability initiatives, and housing investments totaling billions in new spending amid economic uncertainty.

item.title: Briefing: Canada's Parliamentary Budget Officer Flags Critical Fiscal Challenges for Budget 2025
item.description: PBO identifies seven critical fiscal issues facing parliamentarians ahead of Budget 2025, including housing affordability, carbon pricing uncertainty, defence spending gaps, and healthcare system pressures.

item.title: Briefing: Canada's Budget 2025 - Historic Shift Toward Defense, Infrastructure, and Fiscal Discipline
item.description: Canada's Budget 2025 represents a generational pivot from operational spending to capital investment, with $280B allocated over five years toward defense, infrastructure, housing, and productivity while maintaining the lowest net debt-to-GDP ratio in the G7.
